title: Which multiples of twenty five are not multiples of fifty?
description: The multiples of twenty five are written in a row and the multiples of fifty are ringed. The numbers left over are the odd multiples of twenty five, and any three of them fit.
teaching_notes: One idea: every second multiple of twenty five is a multiple of fifty, so the others are not. Watch for students who think fifty is not a multiple of twenty five, or who pick a multiple of fifty.

source: Figure it Out box 2, Q5, p.111
video_script.why: The child lists the multiples of twenty five, rings those that are multiples of fifty, and keeps the rest.
video_script.substitution: List the multiples of the smaller number and remove those that are multiples of the larger.
video_script.anchor: a number strip with jumps of twenty five, every second landing ringed
video_script.payoff_line: Twenty five, seventy five and one hundred and twenty five fit the rule

final_answer.spoken: twenty five, seventy five and one hundred and twenty five, or any odd multiple of twenty five

maths_rules: multiples of 50 among them: 50, 100, 150, every second one
not multiples of 50: 25, 75, 125, 175, the odd multiples of 25
check: 75 lies between 50 and 100, with no multiple of 50 at 75
video_script.design: One idea: every second multiple of twenty five is a multiple of fifty, so the rest are not. Same method as the book example: write the multiples and mark the common ones.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; the numbers 25 and 50 on a number strip with a question mark

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.ask: the question appears with a question mark

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about multiples of twenty five.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Find three numbers that are multiples of twenty five but not multiples of fifty.

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: jumps of 25 along a number strip: 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175

marks.way: the example from the book is pointed to
marks.jump: jumps of 25 are drawn along the strip
marks.fifty: the landings 50, 100 and 150 get a ring

narration: <bookmark mark='way'/>We use the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='jump'/>Multiples of twenty five come by jumping twenty five at a time.
<bookmark mark='fifty'/>Every second landing is also a jump of fifty.

beats.on_screen: Given: multiples of 25 that are not multiples of 50

marks.given: the rule is written under the word Given

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, we want multiples of twenty five that are not multiples of fifty.

beats.on_screen: To find: any three such numbers

marks.find: the words To find are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find any three numbers that fit.

marks.list: the multiples of 25 are written in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='list'/>Step one, write the multiples of twenty five: twenty five, fifty, seventy five, one hundred, and on.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: multiples of 50 among them: 50, 100, 150, every second one
narration: <bookmark mark='fifty'/>Step two, ring those that are also multiples of fifty. They are fifty, one hundred and one hundred and fifty.
<bookmark mark='second'/>They come at every second place in the row.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: the rest are not multiples of 50: 25, 75, 125, 175, ...

marks.rest: the ringed numbers fade and 25, 75, 125, 175 stay
marks.odd: the word odd is written beside the numbers

narration: <bookmark mark='rest'/>Step three, keep the numbers that are not ringed.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>These are the odd multiples of twenty five.

beats.on_screen: Check: 75 lies between 50 and 100, so it is not a multiple of 50

marks.seventyfive: 75 is placed between 50 and 100 on the strip
marks.none: a cross appears over the words multiple of 50

narration: <bookmark mark='seventyfive'/>Step four, check seventy five. It lies between fifty and one hundred.
<bookmark mark='none'/>No multiple of fifty is there, so seventy five is not a multiple of fifty.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 25, 75 and 125 are multiples of 25 but not of 50 (any odd multiple of 25 works)

marks.not: the words multiple of 25 but not of 50 are written
marks.odd: the words any odd multiple appear

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Twenty five, seventy five and one hundred and twenty five fit the rule.
<bookmark mark='not'/>They are multiples of twenty five but not of fifty.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>Any odd multiple of twenty five works.
